frame.physical_scale: One common world/pixel scale calibrated to the existing female SOUTH head width, including ears, at alpha>128. Authored family-scale choice, not a recovered native height.
frame.units: width and center_x are Qud cell-width units (2/3 world); height and center_z are world units. No per-facing rescale.

native_facts: Horns575, paired grooved bone natural equipment on Head288/0. Native data does not specify skull coordinates.
user_interpretation: Symmetric sheep/ram-like grooved horns; preserve this selected interpretation rather than replace it with straight spikes.
root: Each tube starts INSIDE the skull proxy at X+/-32,Y165,Z32, broad radius17. It rises through a curved anterolateral crown emergence region; its hidden starting cross-section is never a flat cap resting on the forehead.
curl: Same original side sweep rises/backwards, then returns forward into a continuous tapered tip. Lateral splay0.75 supplies clearance outside the actual projected skull for the returning loop. No independently drawn rear peg.

skull_proxy.meaning: Authored ellipsoid fitted to existing S/E/N head contours, not native skull coordinates. Used for item/body depth only; original head pixels remain authoritative.

projection.registration: Y uses the same125 reference; E/N add18/16px to match unchanged source head landmarks. Common physical scale; no per-facing bounds fit.

views.south: Front upper crown root interiors lie behind original skull; only the emerging tapered volume is visible. Returning curls are complete outside the head. Flesh ears are unchanged and separate.
views.east: Anterior root rises above/forward of flesh ear, sweeps backwards to screen-left and returns forward. Far horn overlaps exactly. Root begins below the visible emergence, with no open flat cut.
views.north: Anterior bases are hidden by original skull. Posterior horn surfaces and full returning loop clear the skull, so the thin return is not clipped into a peg and disconnected broad bend. Depth/self-occlusion come from the same volume.
views.west: Mirror east geometry and depth for symmetric Head288/0 item; no source/body scale or binding change.

gates: Check complete manual views and root/return closeups before refinement.
Fresh independent review after each contextual refinement, before extraction or fitting.
Numerical clearance is diagnostic; visible attachment and flow must also pass.
